summary: Completed frontend-only verification for /admin/get-in-touch enquiry detail popup with real APIs, one-login session, temporary Mongo fixtures, responsive/layout/accessibility/delete/export regressions, and protected-file integrity check.
critical_code_review_comments: No scope regressions found in ConsultationDetail popup behavior. All tested flows passed with real APIs.
Minor code hygiene: useConsultationEnquiries still sets an Authorization header from localStorage although secureApi strips it and auth is cookie+CSRF based.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 temporary tagged contact_enquiries fixtures (legacy fallback, monthly wizard, variant4, variant5) and deleted only those exact fixture IDs in cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Single browser login/session used to avoid lockout. Real existing viewed record opened via search without exposing personal values. Network interception was used only for negative delete-error simulation (request abort) and delayed-live-delete busy-state assertion; no mocked success responses. Protected source hash verification passed for all 208 tracked files.
rca of the issue: No issue reproduced in current scoped popup validation.
